bank_name: The Nellore Co-Operative Urban Bank Ltd.

website_metadata.notes: No own website for this NSUCB found. Searches return only aggregators/IFSC directories (codeforbanks, prokerala). Registry hint 'prokerala.com' is a directory, not the bank. Note: nelloredccb.com is the Nellore DCCB (Sri Potti Sriramulu Nellore District Cooperative Central Bank) — a DIFFERENT entity, not this urban bank.

warnings: FD product exists per aggregator descriptions but no official rate page; do not confuse with Nellore DCCB (nelloredccb.com).
